intro:
Johannesburg is where Africa's capital gets allocated, and project roles follow the money: the big four banks run continent-scale transformation programmes from Sandton, the mining houses headquartered here execute capital projects across hemispheres, and the energy transition — grid, solar, storage — is staffed largely out of Gauteng. Certified professionals are the currency of this market; PMP appears in corporate role profiles as standard, and agile credentials carry the digital-banking scene. There are live online batches all year for Johannesburg — pick a Saturday–Sunday weekend or a Wednesday–Thursday weekday cohort — each timed to fall within normal Johannesburg working-day hours; the schedule below gives the precise local start and end for every date. Afterwards you get structured exam application support, full-length mock exams, and open trainer access for doubts until you certify.

Johannesburg runs Africa's deepest corporate project market: mining houses, banks and telecoms headquartered here fund continuous capital and digital programs, and their governance frameworks — inherited from listed-company discipline — write certified project leadership into delivery structures. Consultancies staffing those programs extend the requirement across the market. Training is live online over two consecutive days in hours that fit South Africa cleanly, shown on this page in local time. Certified project pay in Johannesburg leads the continent; the sourced entries below give dated local figures for negotiation rather than continental averages. The employer list reflects the mining-banking-telecom demand base, and corporates can certify entire delivery teams through private cohorts aligned to their financial-year calendars.
